run_f_gold: run f_gold to count ways to partition a set of n elements into k non-empty subsets
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using 10 parameter sets and print success count
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold function which uses dynamic programming to compute Stirling numbers of the second kind
review_f_gold: review the f_gold function that builds a 2D DP table with recurrence j*dp[i-1][j] + dp[i-1][j-1]
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use a 1D DP array instead of a 2D table for reduced memory usage
